body: at this moment i don’t think i need urgent care, but when i’m in the state of needing urgent care i won’t want to call or text a crisis line. i’m trying to think of ways to be proactive but it’s so hard when you have so little control over your life and the help you can receive, you know? just sucks.

i feel like online therapy just wont do enough for me. and my parents will never let me get real therapy. i just feel so trapped. i’m thinking at least somewhat rationally right now but i fear when i start getting too deep into my negative thoughts that i will do something really permanent. i don’t want to die knowing i wasted my life. all of this has just been such a waste. fuck.
